source.weightDefinition: Sum of source chemical synapse occurrence counts for each directed pre/post pair. A source annotation ID can contribute to several post-synaptic pairs; summed edge weights are not counts of unique source annotation IDs.

No neural activity, efficacy, causal development or whole-302-neuron coverage is established.

result.identityPolicy: Only exact string IDs are aligned. The caller must establish that their biological identity namespace is comparable; IDs are never inferred from labels or coordinates.
result.distanceConvention: Square-root Jensen-Shannon divergence with base-2 logs after normalizing each shared-node weight distribution. Both empty distributions have distance 0; exactly one empty distribution has distance 1. Empty support Jaccards are 1 and must be interpreted with status.
result.semantics: All comparison metrics use the induced graph on exact shared node IDs, including self loops. Directed rows are pair-aggregated before thresholding. Excluded endpoints and their retained weights are reported separately. Gained and lost mean B-only and A-only observed support, not longitudinal changes in one animal or proof of maturation.
